title: The Knight Comes Back
setup: Black's knight has just gone to b7, from where it can recapture on d8 and do nothing else.
hint: Ask what the recapturing piece will cover once it lands, and what it will stop covering.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxd8+}} forces {{Nxd8}}, the only legal answer. But a knight on d8 covers b7, c6, e6 and f7 — never e8. {{Re8#}} lands on the one square the new defender cannot see. Where a piece recaptures matters as much as whether it can.
